unit.unitinstructions:
Kennesaw Sociology and Criminal Justice Faculty

This tutor covers 27 full-time faculty members from the Kennesaw State University Sociology and Criminal Justice department.

  • Prompt: Each card shows a faculty headshot and research-interest text.
  • Response: Type the faculty member's full name without any middle initial.
  • Source rule: If the department site does not list research interests for a faculty member, the card says so explicitly instead of guessing.

Use the image and research areas together to retrieve the correct name.

learningsession.calculateProbability: p.y = -0.45 + .73* pFunc.logitdec( p.overallOutcomeHistory.slice( Math.max(p.overallOutcomeHistory.length-60,  0),   p.overallOutcomeHistory.length),  .95)+ .52* Math.log(1+p.stimSuccessCount) + 2.17 * pFunc.recency(p.stimSecsSinceLastShown,  .30) ; p.probability = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-p.y));  return p
